title: A Better Critic Matters for Distribution Matching Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.42135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student using the difference between a teacher's score and an online critic's estimate of the student distribution's score. We investigate what the critic needs, in capacity and in information, to provide a reliable training signal. On the capacity side, controlled experiments across seven SiT model sizes on ImageNet show that increasing teacher size while keeping a small critic fixed can degrade student quality and cause training collapse. Scaling the critic alongside the teacher, a strategy we call joint scaling, prevents collapse in our experiments and allows the student to benefit from larger teachers. On the information side, rather than forcing the critic to model a step-agnostic mixture of student outputs, we introduce a step-aware critic (STAC) that conditions on the student's generation step to estimate step-specific scores. translated_title: 更好的评论家对分布匹配蒸馏至关重要
translated_abstract: 分布匹配蒸馏通过教师模型的分数与学生分布分数的在线评论家估计之间的差异，来训练少步学生模型。我们研究了评论家在容量和信息两个方面需要什么，才能提供可靠的训练信号。在容量方面，在ImageNet上对七个SiT模型规模的受控实验表明，在保持小评论家固定的情况下增大教师模型规模，可能会降低学生模型的质量并导致训练崩溃。我们将评论家与教师模型同步扩展的策略称为联合扩展，在我们的实验中它可以防止崩溃，并使学生模型从更大的教师模型中受益。在信息方面，与其强迫评论家去建模一个与步数无关的学生输出混合分布，我们引入了一种步骤感知评论家，它以学生模型的生成步骤为条件来估计特定步骤的分数。联合扩展与步骤感知评论家相结合，能够持续提升学生模型的质量。
tldr: 该论文发现评论家的容量与信息在分布匹配蒸馏中至关重要，提出将评论家与教师模型联合扩展以防止训练崩溃，并引入步骤感知评论家STAC来估计特定步骤的分数，从而持续提升学生模型质量。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that scaling the critic jointly with the teacher prevents training collapse in Distribution Matching Distillation, and introduces a step-aware critic (STAC) that estimates step-specific scores, consistently improving student quality.
